# UltraTextGen — Font styles

> Explore all Unicode font categories. Find bold, cursive, gothic, bubble, strikethrough, and more. Discover what each font signals and where to use it for maximum impact.

26 pages under https://ultratextgen.com/category/, in en. Site index: https://ultratextgen.com/llms.txt. Complete canonical URL list: https://ultratextgen.com/sitemap.xml

## Font styles

- [Unicode Font Categories — Choose Your Visual Intent](https://ultratextgen.com/category/): Typography is not decoration.
- [Aesthetic Font Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/category/aesthetic-fonts/): Generate aesthetic Unicode fonts you can copy and paste for bios, usernames, captions, and profile headers.
- [Ancient & Rune Font Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/category/ancient-fonts/): Convert text into Elder Futhark runes, Cherokee, Ethiopic, Old Italic, and other ancient-script lookalike fonts.
- [Bold Fonts Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/category/bold-fonts/): Create bold Unicode fonts for strong emphasis and high visibility.
- [Bold Italic Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/category/bold-fonts/bold-italic/): Copy and paste bold italic text into Instagram, WhatsApp, Discord & TikTok bios.
- [Bubble Fonts Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/category/bubble-fonts/): Bubble letters A–Z and 0–9: copy-paste bubble fonts for bios and captions, plus large printable outlines you can trace, color, and print.
- [Circle Fonts Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/category/bubble-fonts/circle/): Enclosed circle letter fonts for unique profile names, creative bullet points, and distinctive social posts.
- [Case Converter](https://ultratextgen.com/category/case-converter/): Free online case converter.
- [Redacted & Classified Text Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/category/classified/): Black out your own text with a redacted / classified look.
- [Cursive Name Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/category/cursive-fonts/): Turn any text into 𝓬𝓾𝓻𝓼𝓲𝓿𝓮 you can copy and paste: flowing script fonts, every cursive letter A–Z, the full alphabet, and name…
- [Cute Font Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/category/cute-fonts/): Generate cute Unicode font styles for bios, usernames, and captions.
- [Emoji Letter Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/category/emoji-letter-fonts/): Turn text into emoji block letters, squared letters, and regional-indicator flag letters.
- [Faux Script Font Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/category/faux-fonts/): Turn text into faux Cyrillic (Russian-look), Greek, and Japanese katakana lookalike letters.
- [Fullwidth Text Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/category/fullwidth-fonts/): Convert text into fullwidth vaporwave letters with wide, aesthetic spacing.
- [Gothic Font Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/category/gothic-fonts/): Dark gothic, fraktur, and blackletter fonts for edgy profiles, gaming usernames, metal band aesthetics, and mysterious vibes.
- [Italic Fonts Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/category/italic-fonts/): Generate italic Unicode fonts to add tone and nuance to your text.
- [Novelty Font Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/category/novelty-fonts/): Turn text into keycap number letters, currency-symbol lookalike letters, and other novelty text styles.
- [Old English Font Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/category/old-english-fonts/): Copy and paste blackletter text for name tattoos, sports jerseys, the Old English D, chicano lettering, and band logos.
- [Small Caps Generator (ᴀʙᴄ Style)](https://ultratextgen.com/category/small-caps/): Type a bio line, heading, or label and copy it as real small caps Unicode, no HTML tags, no formatting toolbar.
- [Small Text Generator (ₛₘₐₗₗ & ᵗⁱⁿʸ)](https://ultratextgen.com/category/small-text/): Generate small and tiny Unicode text styles for bios, names, and posts.
- [Strikethrough & Cross Out Text Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/category/strikethrough-text/): Cross out text instantly — single, double, slash, wavy and line-through strikethrough styles to copy and paste.
- [Subscript Generator (H₂O, Footnotes)](https://ultratextgen.com/category/subscript/): Type a chemistry formula, footnote marker, or index and copy it as real subscript Unicode, no HTML tags, no formatting toolbar.
- [Superscript Generator (x², Ordinals, ™)](https://ultratextgen.com/category/superscript/): Type an exponent, ordinal, or whisper-style aside and copy it as real superscript Unicode, no HTML tags, no formatting toolbar.
- [Text Decorator](https://ultratextgen.com/category/text-decorator/): Free text decorator: wrap your words in symbols, emoji borders, brackets, and frames — ★Hello★, ꧁Hello꧂, ❄️Sale❄️.
- [Underline Text Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/category/underline-text/): Underline Text fonts and styles to emphasize your text.
- [Upside Down Text Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/category/upside-down-text/): Flip your text upside down and copy paste instantly.
